title: Fargo, ND — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Fargo, ND: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Fargo is a city in ND with a population of 125,990. Lowest unemployment in America, brutal winters, and surprisingly vibrant arts scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.2.
